case_title: KANAKA REKHA NAIK v. MANOJ KUMAR PRADHAN & ANR.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 147, 326 read with Section 149, IPC and sentenced to seven years rigorous imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused were involved in a riot where the victim was obstructed, assaulted, and burned to death. The trial court found that the accused and others formed an unlawful assembly armed with weapons, which led to the victim's death and subsequent burning of his body. The trial court convicted the accused under Sections 147 and 326 read with Section 149 of the IPC and sentenced them to seven years rigorous imprisonment and fines. The accused appealed, and the High Court granted bail based on the accused being a sitting M.L.A., which the Supreme Court found was an insufficient reason for releasing the accused on bail without considering the serious nature of the allegations and the accused's involvement in multiple similar cases.
